mandate: Raw evidence verification without repair, retraining, or certification by assertion

repository_state.dirty_status: DIRTY (audit working directory has uncommitted validation records)

Q1_ridge_vs_weighted_ensemble_tie.evidence_summary: Ridge and Weighted Ensemble tie within the 0.10 min indifference band on 2023 development (|Delta| = 0.000449 min), but are NOT tied on 2024 post-holdout (|Delta| = 0.4050 min).
Q1_ridge_vs_weighted_ensemble_tie.what_it_does_not_prove: Does NOT prove that Ridge and Weighted Ensemble are universally identical or tied across all temporal distributions or holdouts.

Q2_2023_selection_isolated_from_2024.evidence_summary: scripts/run_academic_model_selection.py trains exclusively on 2016-2022 and selects on 2023. Explicit data guard assert_data_access_allowed(2024, 'development') throws fail-closed error.
Q2_2023_selection_isolated_from_2024.what_it_does_not_prove: Does NOT prove that 2024 data did not exist on the file system; proves only that selection code execution did not access 2024.

Q3_solver_budget_equal_compute.evidence_summary: All 4 solvers were configured with an equal wall-clock time limit T = 2.0s and single-worker thread. However, actual computational work is fundamentally unequal: Greedy runs in 1.1ms (O(N log M) heuristic), CP-SAT proves optimality in 0.44s, SA spins for 2.0009s (2351 iterations).
Q3_solver_budget_equal_compute.what_it_does_not_prove: Does NOT prove equal computational FLOPs, CPU cycles, or branch-and-bound node evaluations across paradigms.

Q4_hybrid_zero_marginal_gain.evidence_summary: In all 28 evaluated cases (100%), hybrid objective value minus CP-SAT objective value is exactly 0.0. CP-SAT solves the 2024 synthetic scenarios to proven global optimality in <0.5s, providing SA with an already optimal warm start that cannot be improved.
Q4_hybrid_zero_marginal_gain.what_it_does_not_prove: Does NOT prove that SA would have zero gain on intractable NP-hard instances where CP-SAT fails to converge within its time budget.

Q5_dataset_solver_28_vs_84_scope.evidence_summary: R26 evaluates 28 problem instances (4 seasonal 2024 scenarios x 7 models including oracle) x 4 solvers = 112 runs. R21 evaluated 84 runs (4 development scenarios x 7 ML models x 3 solvers without hybrid). They represent two distinct benchmark sets.
Q5_dataset_solver_28_vs_84_scope.what_it_does_not_prove: Does NOT prove that R26 is a 1-to-1 rerun of R21; R26 is an independent post-holdout re-certification benchmark.

Q6_actual_sha256_verification.evidence_summary: Actual byte-level SHA256 hashes of all 31 critical artifacts were computed directly from disk and match reference freeze manifests and sidecar files with 0 mismatches.
Q6_actual_sha256_verification.what_it_does_not_prove: Does NOT prove substantive scientific validity by itself; cryptographic hashes prove only byte integrity and immutability.

Q7_r21_124_execution_accounting.evidence_summary: The 224 execution units in R29 comprise 124 fresh rebuilt executions (Selection: 10, Downstream: 84, MC: 30) and 100 reused/frozen evidence units. The '48 statistical runs' are Holm-Bonferroni paired comparison families across 10 model pairs, not standalone training runs.
Q7_r21_124_execution_accounting.what_it_does_not_prove: Does NOT prove that 48 end-to-end model training runs took place in the statistics family; they are statistical hypothesis tests computed on point predictions.

Q8_p4_continuous_distribution_calibratio.evidence_summary: P4 provides an explicit parametric continuous density (Student-T with mu, sigma, df >= 2.1), exact continuous CRPS (17.15 min), and exact NLL (4.032). However, empirical PIT and confidence calibration are NOT separately certified.
Q8_p4_continuous_distribution_calibratio.what_it_does_not_prove: Does NOT prove empirical calibration or coverage guarantees across all forecast quantiles.

Q9_cross_machine_bit_reproducibility.evidence_summary: Reproduction is certified within the contained specification (Python 3.11.15, Windows 10 AMD64, deterministic seeds). Universal bit-for-bit replication across arbitrary OS/CPU environments is not guaranteed due to floating-point differences.
Q9_cross_machine_bit_reproducibility.what_it_does_not_prove: Does NOT prove bit-identical floating-point output on ARM/Linux or across differing BLAS/MKL linear algebra implementations.

Q10_certification_tests_strength.evidence_summary: Certification tests in tests/test_r24_certification_gate.py combine actual byte hash checks and numeric sanity checks with structural manifest validations. They go beyond text-presence tests but remain bounded by manifest-defined schemas.
Q10_certification_tests_strength.what_it_does_not_prove: Does NOT constitute a full end-to-end retraining test from raw BTS CSV data on every run.
